name: MQTT switch (ESPHome, Home Assistant style, any ON/OFF topic)

settings.label: Command topic, for ESPHome <node>/switch/<name>/command
settings.help:
The topic the switch listens on for ON and OFF.
For ESPHome it is <node>/switch/<name>/command, where node is the device name in its YAML and name is the switch name in lower case with underscores.

settings.label: State topic, for ESPHome <node>/switch/<name>/state
settings.help:
The topic the switch reports ON or OFF on.
For ESPHome it is <node>/switch/<name>/state.

settings.label: Broker user
settings.help: The user name your MQTT broker asks for. Leave it empty if the broker takes anyone. It is in the broker's settings, for example the Mosquitto add-on's Logins in Home Assistant.

settings.label: Broker password (one per broker and user, shared by its devices)
settings.help: The password for the broker user. It stays on this phone and is never shown again. Leave it empty if the broker has no password.
